en: Monochrome postcard showing an interior view of an armory hall filled with suits of plate armor and helmets. In the foreground on the right is a life‑size armored horse with a rider's armor, set on a low platform. To the left and in the background are rows of standing armors and many helmets hanging from the ceiling. The caption printed at the bottom reads in German and mentions Graz and the Landeszeughaus (provincial armory).
